_comment: Every figure must have source, url, year, and accessed. 'TODO' values need manual verification before launch.

tax._source: HMRC — Income Tax rates and Personal Allowances
tax._note: rUK thresholds confirmed unchanged from 2024-25 on gov.uk for 6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027

ruk._note: Bands are taxable income above personal allowance

scotland._source: Scottish Government — Income Tax in Scotland
scotland._note: Bands are taxable income above personal allowance (gov.uk gross figures minus £12,570). Top rate starts at £125,140 taxable income: the PA is fully tapered by then, so taxable = gross.

ni._source: HMRC — National Insurance: rates and categories
ni._note: Weekly PT £242 / UEL £967 on gov.uk = annual £12,570 / £50,270. Class 1 employee contributions. Same rates for rUK and Scotland.

odaTmeRatio._description: UK overseas aid as a share of total expenditure on services (not Total Managed Expenditure). Used in HMRC Annual Tax Summary methodology to show 'overseas aid' spending line.
odaTmeRatio._source: HMRC — How public spending was calculated in your tax summary
odaTmeRatio._note: Overseas aid line: £7.7bn (0.7%). £7.7bn ODA ÷ £1,156.4bn expenditure on services = 0.667%. Not used in model; kept for reference.

expenditureOnServices._description: UK government expenditure on services — the HMRC Annual Tax Summary denominator. Used to convert an individual's tax into a proportional share of total government spending.
expenditureOnServices._source: HM Treasury — Public Expenditure Statistical Analyses (PESA) 2025, total expenditure on services 2024-25 (£1,156,393m); method per HMRC Annual Tax Summary guidance
expenditureOnServices._note: £1,156,393m rounded to £1,156.4bn. HMRC's Annual Tax Summary spending shares are based on PESA table 5.2 under the expenditure on services framework.

childHealthODA._description: Annual UK ODA to child health (3-year average 2022–2024). LOW = sector codes (SpecificSectorCode in FCDO SID data) 13020/12240/12250/12262 + Gavi multilateral core contributions. HIGH adds 12220/13030/12261.
childHealthODA._source: FCDO — Statistics on International Development: final UK ODA spend 2024, data underlying SID 2017–2024
childHealthODA._gaviNote: Gavi (Vaccine Alliance) multilateral core contributions are captured via channel-of-delivery filter, not sector code, because core contributions support Gavi's pooled vaccine procurement and cannot be attributed to a single sector code.

childHealthODA2026_27._description: Estimated UK child health ODA for 2026–27, same definition as childHealthODA (LOW/HIGH sector codes + Gavi core contributions). Drives the 'Now' side of the Before vs Now view.
childHealthODA2026_27._status: PLACEHOLDER — estimate pending ONE data team. Do not fill with an invented number. Replace low/high with the ONE data team's estimate and add _source, _url and _accessed.

pledges._note: UK multi-year pledges, in GBP millions. Annualised in src/compare.js as total ÷ years in the pledge period (assumes even disbursement across the period).

before._source: GOV.UK — British High Commissioner meets Special Adviser to the Prime Minister on health ahead of the Global Vaccines Summit in the UK: 'The UK is proud to pledge £1.65 billion to Gavi for 2021-2025.'

now._source: GOV.UK — UK partners with Gavi to help save up to 8 million lives by 2030: £1.25 billion for 2026 to 2030

before._source: GOV.UK — UK aid will save over one million lives from killer diseases: £1 billion over 3 years, 'in response to the Global Fund's seventh replenishment for 2023 to 2025'

now._source: GOV.UK — UK Biological Security Strategy: Implementation Report, July 2025 - July 2026: 'the UK's £850 million commitment (2026-2028)' to the Global Fund's Eighth Replenishment. Also stated in the Foreign Secretary's statement on international development, 19 March 2026 (_alsoUrl).

costs._note: All unit costs in USD. Converted to GBP at runtime using meta.usdGbp.

vaccineDtp._description: Cost per dose of pentavalent vaccine (DTP-HepB-Hib) at UNICEF procurement prices.
vaccineDtp._source: UNICEF Supply Division — Vaccine price data
vaccineDtp._note: Low reflects minimum UNICEF catalogue price; high includes cold-chain/delivery margin.

bednet._description: Cost per long-lasting insecticidal net (LLIN) distributed, including logistics.
bednet._source: Against Malaria Foundation — Cost per net distributed
bednet._note: AMF publishes audited per-net costs for each distribution. Range covers country variation.

orsTreatment._description: Cost per full ORS + zinc treatment course for child diarrhoea, per WHO/UNICEF joint guidance.
orsTreatment._source: UNICEF Supply Division — ORS and Zinc
orsTreatment._note: Low = ORS only, minimum course (2 × $0.07 sachet). High = ORS + zinc co-pack per WHO/UNICEF joint statement.
orsTreatment.itemLabel: full ORS + zinc treatment (per WHO/UNICEF guidance)
orsTreatment.itemLabelPlural: full ORS + zinc treatments (per WHO/UNICEF guidance)

usdGbp._description: USD to GBP exchange rate used to convert unit costs.
usdGbp._source: Bank of England — Annual average spot exchange rate

petitionUrl._description: URL for the Born to Live petition on ONE's website.
